description:
The cryo-winder at Confederacy Central Command coils frost-moth superfluid helium into the cores of Control Nodes, and the winding head waits on its feed. Frost-moths cross the ice fields and keep vials only while helium ice feeds them.

Dropped by: Frost-Moth (only where it still feeds on Helium Ice).

The station's Superfluid Winder uses it.

dialog.offer: The winder's technician logs a need for 10 of Superfluid Vial, sealed and kept cold in transit. Superfluid finds the smallest gap in a container, and the technician finds the cause.

objectives.description: Deliver 10 Superfluid Vial to Confederacy Central Command

title: Station Need: Superfluid Vial
